title: Storybound quest
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/quests/<path>.json — a quest with a state (unknown, active, completed, failed) and stages with objectives.

category.description: Group in the Quests tab; name: '<ns>.quest.category.<path>'. Built in: main, side, contract.

scope.description: Whose progress this is: one player's, the party's (shared by members) or the whole world's.

description.description: Shown above the stage log when 'text' has nothing for the current state.

text.description: Description per state, shown above the stage log.

start.description: Starts the quest for the player when the trigger fires and the conditions pass. Without it, start the quest with set_quest_state or set_quest_stage.

stages.description: In order; the quest starts at the first one.

fail_when.description: Checked every second while the quest is active; when it holds, the quest fails.

on_complete.description: Story effects, run once (for the player who finished the quest).

rewards.description: For every online player sharing the quest, so each party member is paid. An action list (the older way) runs at once on completion; the object waits in the Journal for Claim (claim: false gives it at once when it fits and nothing is to be chosen). Never dropped on the ground.

choice.description: One of them, picked by the player when claiming.

loot.description: A loot table, rolled when the quest is completed.

claim.description: Wait for the Journal's Claim button.

notify.description: Show toasts when the quest starts, advances and ends.

repeatable.description: After the quest is completed or failed, its start trigger starts it again once cooldown seconds of game time have passed, at most times completions in all. true: at once, without a limit.

difficulty.description: Stars (1-5) or a level id of the scale in project.json (easy, normal, hard, deadly by default); the n-th level is n stars.

time_limit.description: Seconds of game time from the start; then the quest fails (on_failed runs). Shown as a clock in the Journal and on the HUD.

map_visibility.description: How the players' chapter map (project.json chapter_map) shows the quest before the player starts it: visible as it is; secret as ??? until every quest before it is completed; invisible not at all until it starts.

id.description: The item, written as an item stack.

log.description: The stage's entry in the quest's story, shown from the moment the stage is reached.

objectives.description: The stage ends when every required objective reaches its count. Without required objectives it waits for set_quest_stage or set_quest_state.

next.description: A stage id, @complete or @fail. Omitted: the following stage, or completion after the last one.

waypoints.description: Static waypoints shown while the quest is at this stage.

id.description: Defaults to the objective's position in the stage.

text.description: The line in the Quests tab and on the HUD; an objective without text is not shown.

optional.description: Counted and shown, but not needed to finish the stage.

hint.description: Shown under the objective in the Quests tab until the objective is done.

hints.description: Shown under the objective (and, dimmed, on the HUD) while their conditions hold and, with after, once the objective has not moved for that many seconds. Checked every second on the server.

after.description: Seconds without progress on the objective (the player is stuck).

items.description: count items to have; with consume, to hand in (taken as they come). Without a trigger they are looked at every second, with one when it fires (bring 10 hides, then talk to the tanner).
